arguments.explanation: Flags a random sample of about 1% of transactions for manual review. Each transaction is chosen independently, so the sample differs on every evaluation.
assumptions: 'Random 1%' means each transaction has an independent 1-in-100 chance of being flagged, not a fixed set of exactly 1% of rows.
The sample is not reproducible: each run of the rule flags a different set of transactions.
The rule does not look at transaction content, so it is not a fraud signal; it only provides an unbiased review sample.
